details.summary:
The Skandagiri Sunrise Trek is one of the most rewarding early-morning trekking experiences near Bangalore.

Located near Chikkaballapur, approximately 60–70 km from Bangalore, Skandagiri Hills rises to around 1,450 metres above sea level. The trail combines rocky terrain, forest sections, historic ruins and panoramic hilltop views, making it an ideal choice for travellers looking for a short but memorable adventure.

Your journey begins late at night in Bangalore. Travel comfortably to Skandagiri, meet your trek leader and begin your ascent in the early hours of the morning.

As you climb through the darkness, the excitement builds with every step. The reward comes at the summit, where you can watch the sky slowly change colour as the sun rises over the surrounding hills.

On favourable mornings, mist and clouds may cover the valleys below, creating Skandagiri's famous sea-of- clouds experience.

activities.title: Pickup from Bangalore
activities.description:
Your Skandagiri adventure begins late at night.

Meet your trip coordinator at the designated pickup point and board the vehicle for your journey towards Chikkaballapur.

Sit back, relax and get to know your fellow travellers as you leave Bangalore behind.

activities.title: Arrive at Skandagiri base
activities.description:
Reach the designated base/parking area and prepare for the trek.

After a short safety briefing from your trek leader, get your headlamp ready and begin the climb.

itinerary.title: Skandagiri sunrise trek
itinerary.meals: Breakfast stop at your own expense unless included in your selected package

activities.title: Begin the Trek
activities.description:
Start your ascent towards the Skandagiri summit under the night sky.

The trail takes you through forested sections and uneven terrain, gradually becoming more rocky as you gain elevation.

Maintain a comfortable pace and stay together with the group.

activities.title: Approach the Summit
activities.description:
As you climb higher, the darkness slowly begins to fade.

The surrounding landscape starts appearing in the first light of dawn, building anticipation for the sunrise ahead.

activities.title: Reach the Summit
activities.description:
Reach the summit and settle in for the highlight of your Skandagiri Sunrise Trek.

Watch the morning sky transform as the sun rises over the surrounding hills.

On favourable mornings, you may see clouds and mist spread across the valleys below.

Take photographs, enjoy the views and spend some quiet time soaking in the atmosphere.

activities.title: Explore Kalavara Durga
activities.description:
After sunrise, explore the historic remains around the summit.

Learn more about the old fortifications and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding countryside.

activities.title: Begin the Descent
activities.description:
Start your descent with your trek leader.

With daylight now covering the trail, you'll get to experience Skandagiri from an entirely different perspective.

activities.title: Trek Ends
activities.description: Reach the base and take some time to rest and freshen up.

activities.title: Breakfast Stop
activities.description:
Stop at a local restaurant or en-route eatery for breakfast.

Breakfast is not included unless specifically mentioned in the selected package.

activities.title: Return to Bangalore
activities.description: Board the vehicle and begin your journey back to Bangalore.

activities.title: Bangalore Drop
activities.description: Arrive back in Bangalore and conclude your Skandagiri Hills Trek experience.

inclusions: Applicable trekking/Forest Department permissions, where included in the selected package
exclusions: Any service not specifically mentioned under Inclusions

pageSections.tagline: Chase the Sunrise. Walk Above the Clouds.
pageSections.introduction:
Looking for an exciting weekend trek from Bangalore? Escape the city and experience the magic of a sunrise from Skandagiri Hills, one of Karnataka's most popular trekking destinations.

Join CompareMyTrip for an unforgettable Skandagiri Sunrise Trek from Bangalore, complete with convenient transportation, trek coordination and an experienced trek leader.

sections.title: A trek with a story
sections.body:
Skandagiri isn't only about sunrise views.

The hill is also known as Kalavara Durga and is home to the remains of an old hill fort traditionally associated with the Palegar era of Karnataka.

As you explore the summit, you'll come across remnants of the historic fortifications and structures that once occupied the hill.

The hill is also locally associated with the name Kalavara Betta, while the name Skandagiri is connected with Skanda, another name for Lord Subramanya.

This combination of history, nature and adventure gives the Skandagiri Trek a character of its own.

sections.title: Why choose Skandagiri for your next weekend escape?
sections.body:
If you're searching for a sunrise trek near Bangalore, Skandagiri offers an excellent mix of adventure and accessibility.

You don't need to take several days off work or travel deep into the mountains. With an overnight journey from Bangalore, you can trek to the summit, experience the sunrise and return to the city the same day.

It is perfect for:

• First-time trekkers looking for a moderate challenge • Friends planning a weekend adventure • Couples looking for an outdoor experience • Solo travellers who enjoy group trips • Adventure enthusiasts looking for treks near Bangalore

Important: Trek timings and access are subject to Forest Department regulations, weather conditions and operational requirements. Sunrise and sea-of-cloud views are natural phenomena and cannot be guaranteed.

sections.title: Things to carry
sections.body: Since the trek begins during the early hours, packing the right essentials is important.

items.title: Must carry
items.body:
• Small trekking backpack
• At least 2 litres of drinking water
• Headlamp or torch
• Trekking shoes with good grip
• Light jacket or windcheater
• Extra pair of socks
• Cap
• Sunglasses
• Sunscreen
• Energy bars or dry fruits
• Personal medication
• Fully charged mobile phone
• Power bank
• Valid government-issued ID

items.title: During monsoon
items.body:
• Rain jacket or poncho
• Waterproof backpack cover
• Waterproof phone pouch
• Extra clothes/socks

items.title: Packing tip
items.body: Keep your backpack light. Avoid carrying unnecessary items as you'll be walking for several hours over uneven terrain.

sections.title: Skandagiri trek trail guidelines
sections.body:
Trek Responsibly. Respect the Hills. 🌿

Skandagiri is both a natural and historical destination. Help preserve it for future travellers.

• Follow your trek leader's instructions at all times. • Follow Forest Department rules and restrictions. • Stay with the group. • Remain on the designated trekking trail. • Do not litter. • Carry all waste back with you.

• Avoid single-use plastic. • Do not smoke or consume alcohol during the trek. • Do not light fires or campfires. • Do not disturb wildlife. • Do not damage plants or historical structures. • Be careful around steep and rocky sections. • Avoid standing too close to edges for photographs. • Wear appropriate trekking footwear. • Stay hydrated. • Take breaks whenever required. • Avoid loud music that may disturb wildlife and fellow trekkers.

Leave Only Footprints. Take Only Memories.

items.title: Is Skandagiri Sunrise Trek suitable for beginners?
items.body:
Yes. The Skandagiri Trek is generally considered a moderate trek and is suitable for beginners with reasonable fitness.

The trail includes rocky, uneven and occasionally steep sections.

items.title: How difficult is Skandagiri Trek?
items.body:
Skandagiri is rated Moderate.

You should be comfortable walking for several hours over uneven terrain and handling uphill and downhill sections.

items.title: How far is Skandagiri from Bangalore?
items.body: Skandagiri Hills is approximately 60–70 KM from Bangalore, depending on your starting point and route.

items.title: How long is the Skandagiri Trek?
items.body: The total trekking distance is approximately 7–9 KM round trip.

items.title: What is the altitude of Skandagiri?
items.body: Skandagiri reaches approximately 1,450 metres / 4,750 feet above sea level.

items.title: Is Skandagiri a sunrise trek?
items.body:
Yes. The Skandagiri Sunrise Trek is designed around reaching the summit around sunrise.

However, exact timings can vary depending on Forest Department regulations and operating conditions.

items.title: Will we definitely see the sunrise?
items.body:
Sunrise visibility depends on weather and cloud conditions.

While Skandagiri is famous for its sunrise views, sunrise visibility cannot be guaranteed.

items.title: Can we see the sea of clouds?
items.body:
You may experience Skandagiri's famous sea of clouds during favourable weather conditions.

It is a natural phenomenon and therefore cannot be guaranteed.

items.title: What shoes should I wear for Skandagiri Trek?
items.body:
Wear trekking shoes or sturdy sports shoes with good grip.

Avoid slippers, sandals and smooth-soled footwear.

items.title: How much water should I carry?
items.body: Carry approximately 2 litres of water per person.

items.title: Is breakfast included in the Skandagiri Trek package?
items.body:
Breakfast is not included unless specifically mentioned in your selected package.

A breakfast stop may be arranged during the return journey.

items.title: Can solo travellers join the Skandagiri Trek?
items.body:
Yes. Solo travellers are welcome to join our group departures.

It's a great opportunity to meet fellow travellers while exploring the hills.

items.title: Is Skandagiri good for couples?
items.body: Yes. Skandagiri is a popular weekend adventure for couples who enjoy nature, trekking and sunrise experiences.

items.title: Can children join the trek?
items.body:
Age eligibility can vary depending on the selected departure and applicable regulations.

Please check the specific departure details before booking.

items.title: What happens if it rains?
items.body:
Rain can make the trail slippery and more challenging.

If weather conditions create a safety concern, trek timings or the itinerary may be modified.

items.title: Is transportation included?
items.body: Yes. Round-trip transportation from designated Bangalore pickup points is included in the standard CompareMyTrip Skandagiri Sunrise Trek package.

items.title: Is Skandagiri Trek safe?
items.body:
The trek should be undertaken with the designated trek leader and according to Forest Department guidelines.

Stay with the group, follow safety instructions and avoid taking unnecessary risks.
